newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile posts $267 million trade deficit in August.
newsitem.headline: Chile posts $267 million trade deficit in August.

text.p: Chile's trade deficit widened to $267 million in August from $76 million in the same month last year, the Central Bank reported.
The figure was in line with Chile's trend toward a significant trade deficit this year after a $1.4 billion surplus in 1995.
The August figure came on exports of $1.17 billion and exports of $1.44 billion, the Central Bank said.
Details on the figures were due to be released later.
